criteria.name: hook_strength
criteria.description: The first 3 seconds must make the viewer stop scrolling.

criteria.name: narrative_clarity
criteria.description: One clear thread from hook to payoff; no confusing jumps.

criteria.name: pacing
criteria.description: Rhythmic cuts, no dead air, energy rises toward the payoff.

criteria.name: emotional_impact
criteria.description: The short leaves a feeling: laughter, awe, tension, warmth.

criteria.name: moment_selection
criteria.description: The genuinely best raw moments were used, not filler.

notes: Seed rubric. Will be refined from the pilot user's evaluations.
